newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U says to work with Prizm in opthamology.
newsitem.headline: P&U says to work with Prizm in opthamology.

text.p: U.S./Swedish drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn on Wednesday said it was to cooperate with private drug company Prizm Pharmaceuticals to develop pantarin for opthalmic applications.
P&U said in a statement that pantarin, a protein-based drug, can be used specifically to prevent post cataract opacification.
Post cataract opacification occurs in 30-50 percent of patients who have undergone lens replacement after cataract surgery.
P&U said it had made an equity investment in Prizm, a private company founded in 1992, and will support research and development activities. No financial details were released.
P&U will be responsible for clinical trials, manufacturing and marketing on a world-wide basis.
Prizm pharmaceuticals uses growth factor biology for drug discovery and development of therapeutic products to treat a broad range of human diseases.
